hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A DEX aggregator hook that intercepts Uniswap v4 swaps in beforeSwap, queries up to 6 V3/V4 liquidity pools hardcoded in bytecode, sorts them by effective price, and routes the trade across pools using BeforeSwapDelta. Liquidity additions and pool initialization are gated to a hardcoded admin address via tx.origin check.
